INSERT INTO private.financial_report(borrower_id,fiscal_year,revenue,net_profit)
          SELECT id,extract($1 from approval_date)::int-$2,greatest(amount*$3,$4),round(greatest(amount*$5,$6)*$7,$8) FROM stage_loans
          UNION ALL SELECT id,$9,greatest(amount*($10+id%$11),$12),round(greatest(amount*($13+id%$14),$15)*(id%$16-$17)/$18,$19) FROM

INSERT INTO credit.loan_contract
          SELECT s.id,s.id,l.lender_id,s.source_id,s.source_row,s.approval_date,s.amount,
          CASE WHEN s.status IN ($1,$2) THEN $3 ELSE round(s.amount*($4+s.id%$5)/$6,$7) END,
          s.term_months,s.status,$8 FROM stage_loans s JOIN credit.lender l ON l.name=s.lender
UPDATE credit.loan_contract SET outstanding=$1 WHERE replace(status_code,$2,$3) IN ($4,$5) AND outstanding<>$6
INSERT INTO credit.borrower SELECT id,$1||id,region,industry,$2 FROM stage_loans

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE,BUFFERS,SETTINGS,FORMAT JSON) WITH top_profit AS (SELECT borrower_id,net_profit FROM private.financial_report WHERE fiscal_year=$1 ORDER BY net_profit DESC,borrower_id LIMIT $2)
 SELECT b.case_code,t.net_profit,d.debt FROM top_profit t JOIN credit.borrower b USING(borrower_id)
